meta.problem:
Katie has a huge collection of colorful pens; she has 33 of them! If she were to describe the pen collection in number of dozens, it would be 33/12, or 2 and 9/12 dozens. Show the number of dozens of pens on the number line.
What is the fraction in the problem?

hintsPerCorrectStep: Enter 33 in the box.
Enter 12 in the box.
If you want to convert the fraction to a mixed number, click "Convert", if not, simply click on the number line to place your fraction to complete the problem.
Please provide your answer 'No_Value' in the highlighted element.
Please provide your answer 'No_Value' in the highlighted element.
Convert the improper fraction on the left into a mixed number, and enter the integer part of the mixed number into this box.
What is the maximum number of 12/12 that can fit into 33/12?
You can also find this out by dividing the numerator by the denominator, and see how many times 12 fits into 33.
Please enter '2' in the highlighted field.
Convert the improper fraction on the left into a mixed number, and enter the numerator part into this box.
Numerator of the mixed number is the remainder of the division between the numerator and the denominator of the improper fraction!
Divide 33 by 12. What is its remainder?
Please enter '-' in the highlighted field.
Convert the improper fraction on the left into a mixed number, and enter the denominator part into this box.
Did you know that conversion between mixed number from improper fraction never changes the denominator?
Please enter '-' in the highlighted field.
Click on the spot where you would find 33/12.
Imagine the number line being divided into 12 parts.
Think of it this way: 33/12 is only 3 parts to the left of "3" or 36/12. If this is still too difficult, try to imagine what "3 parts out of 12" looks like.
You've done everything correctly. Please click on the "Done" button to move on!
